title: ProbePlanner: an auditable software workflow for MRI-CCF probe trajectory planning in mouse electrophysiology
description: Maintained ProbePlanner application release. It adds a separate read-only CCF+MRI research viewer, memory-aware mesh loading, launcher-bound browser sessions and byte-preserving downloads of saved planning replay records. This software release does not replace the frozen v0.3.0-paper release or its evidence. MRI data are supplied separately. Software checks do not establish subject-specific anatomical accuracy, native-space surgical safety or implantation accuracy. The MIT license applies to software.
